subject.title: Add a Sealos Devbox SSH-lease provider

question: Should Crabbox accept a built-in Sealos Devbox SSH-lease provider based on the DevBox CRD, Secret, and SSHGate or NodePort contract now, and what live-proof or waiver bar should apply to https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/682?
rationale: This adds a new built-in provider, config surface, authentication path, Kubernetes Secret handling, and lifecycle mutation behavior, so automation cannot choose the product and security contract on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Approve With Proof Gate
options.body: Continue reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/682 and require redacted live doctor, warmup, status, SSH/run, stop/delete, and zero-residue proof or an explicit maintainer waiver before merge.

options.title: Defer Until Contract Is Confirmed
options.body: Keep the issue and linked PR open until the supported Sealos automation surface, SSH routing, and retained-release semantics are confirmed.

options.title: Reject Built-In Scope
options.body: Close or redirect the request to `ssh` or `external` provider documentation if maintainers do not want Crabbox to own a Sealos-specific adapter.

recommendation.title: Approve With Proof Gate
recommendation.body: Continue reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/682 and require redacted live doctor, warmup, status, SSH/run, stop/delete, and zero-residue proof or an explicit maintainer waiver before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is recent provider registry, KubeVirt key-safety, and Sealos lifecycle hardening work across current main and the active PR.
